snippet.title: CONTROL Resonant - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Manhattan has never faced a crisis like this. Reality has been twisted and bent by an invading cosmic force. Only Dylan Faden can stop this paranatural geophysical nightmare.

CONTROL Resonant arrives September 24th 2026 to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC via Steam and Epic Games Store. Pre-order now!

PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017682/
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9p092299fsgw
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3669870/CONTROL_Resonant/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/control-resonant-3568d3

Developed and published by Remedy Entertainment.

Find out more at https://controlgame.com/
